steering_committee.q97.value: Governance: provide the NSC with a simple dashboard showing approved projects, decisions, and deadlines at a glance. Allow users to work offline and automatically synchronize their actions, maintaining a reliable record of who did what. Proposal review: simplify the process for NGOs so they can submit a proposal, quickly check compliance, evaluate it against OP8 criteria (ecosystems, land, agriculture/fisheries, waste, inclusion), and receive a clear NSC decision. Provide scoring grids adapted to local realities and a library of Guinean projects with practical examples. Learning: provide lightweight e-learning modules downloadable to a phone or USB drive for training on SGP/GEF, ethics, and monitoring and evaluation, even without connectivity. Create an exchange space, such as a forum or WhatsApp group, where NSC members, the secretariat, and NGOs can ask questions, share tips, and support one another. Accessibility: connect the SGP platform to tools staff already know to avoid confusion. Prioritize offline functionality because many users work in areas with weak or no connectivity. Establish support points in prefectures to help rural NGOs submit and track projects.
